issue.title: api error UnknownError: UnknownError with v6.57.0
issue.body:
### Terraform and AWS Provider Version

```console
Terraform v1.11.4
on darwin_arm64
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws v6.57.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/azuread v3.9.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/random v3.9.0
+ provider registry.terraform.io/integrations/github v6.13.0
```

### Affected Resource(s) or Data Source(s)

_No response_

### Expected Behavior

Reading SSM parameters, IAM policies and other sources is working without errors

### Actual Behavior

When using v6.57.0 I'm getting several api error UnknownError: UnknownError errors when running a terraform plan or apply.
When downgrading to v6.56.0 it is working fine

### Relevant Error/Panic Output

```console
Error: reading SSM Parameter (<parameter path>): operation error SSM: GetParameter, https response error StatusCode: 400, RequestID: <request id>, api error SerializationException: UnknownError

Error: reading IAM Policy (arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess): operation error IAM: GetPolicy, https response error StatusCode: 302, RequestID: <request id>, api error UnknownError: UnknownError

Error: reading IAM OIDC Provider (https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com): operation error IAM: ListOpenIDConnectProviders, https response error StatusCode: 302, RequestID: <request id>, api error UnknownError: UnknownError
```


### Sample Terraform Configuration

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand configuration</summary>

```hcl
data "aws_iam_policy" "managed" {
  arn = "arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnlyAccess"
}
```
</details>


### Steps to Reproduce

Upgrade to v6.57.0 and run a terraform plan / apply

### Debug Logging

<details open>
<summary>Click to expand log output</summary>

```console

```
</details>


### GenAI / LLM Assisted Development

n/a

### Important Facts and References

_No response_

### Would you like to implement a fix?

No
